days.notes: Carry water, rain gear, and sturdy shoes. The trek is doable in moderate pace; return before dark to avoid monsoon rains.

days.notes: Allow extra 30 minutes for possible monsoon‑related road checks. No strenuous activities on the final day.

warnings: Early June still marks the start of the monsoon; rain can make trails slippery and some sites (Bhagsunag Temple/Waterfall) may close temporarily.
Taxi fares to McLeod Ganj are often inflated – insist on meter rates (₹12‑₹15 per km) or book via a reputable app.
Unlicensed guides at Bhagsu may overcharge; use official guides from the Dharamshala Tourist Information Centre (₹200‑₹300).
Road to Kangra Fort can experience landslide alerts in heavy rain; check local updates before departure.

Overpriced McLeod Ganj taxi rides – drivers often quote flat rates of ₹1,200‑₹1,500 for the 5 km stretch, inflating the fare up to 3× the metered price. Mitigation: Insist on the meter (₹12‑₹15 per km) or book via a reputable app such as “Himachal Taxi” that shows the estimated fare before booking.

Unlicensed guide fees at Bhagsu – scammers pose as official trekking guides and charge ₹1,000‑₹1,500 for a 30‑minute walk. Mitigation: Hire guides only from the Dharamsala Tourist Information Centre (official fee ₹200‑₹300) or use verified app‑based guides.

Monsoon‑related closures – Bhagsunag Temple and Bhagsu Waterfall are typically closed during heavy monsoon (July‑August) due to flash‑flood risk; Kangra Fort is also closed during monsoon‑induced landslide alerts (usually July). Mitigation: Visit these sites early in June before the heaviest rains, and check local alerts before setting out.
Dalai Lama Temple entry is free (donations optional) but early mornings (7:00‑9:00 am) attract large crowds; arrive early to avoid long queues.
Bhagsunag Temple involves a short steep climb of ~200 m; not recommended for travellers with limited mobility and may be hazardous on wet monsoon days.
Local taxis and auto‑rickshaws charge ₹30‑₹40 per km for auto‑rickshaws and ₹12‑₹15 per km for taxis; always ask for a meter or agree on a fare beforehand to avoid inflation.
Road to McLeod Ganj can be congested near the bus depot; plan to travel after the main town has settled to avoid traffic bottlenecks.
personalization_notes: Spiritual focus – Dalai Lama Temple and Bhagsunag Temple were prioritized to match your meditation interest.
Nature‑oriented day (Triund trek) aligns with the ‘nature’ travel style while keeping the hike moderate for a solo traveller.
Budget‑friendly meals and transport keep the overall cost within a modest budget without compromising local flavor.
